description: Starts profiling an app on a device (one session at a time): CPU, memory, frames and logcat over adb, plus screens, stalls, StrictMode and layouts once the app's in-app Lionscope SDK connects. Replaces the current session and clears its recording, as Start in the dashboard does. The app does not have to run yet: the session waits for its process (status waiting_for_process). Returns the new session; check status for the SDK link.
name: start_session
title: Start profiling
